links.reported_relation: Forcing ETH onto the Slipstream SwapRouter via selfdestruct makes every subsequent swapAndBridgeWithETH/swapAndBridgeWithERC20 call fail.
The victim's swapAndBridge transaction calls exactInput and the router attempts to refund its ETH balance to TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter.
The refund transfer to TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter reverts because it lacks receive/fallback, so the whole swap-and-bridge transaction reverts.
